how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stonetalon-mountains-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1061:obj:0: Speak with Seereth Stonebreak in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1061:details:0: The spirits of the ⟦E1⟧ are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land. So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

rows.quest:1061:details:2: Meet Seereth in Stonetalon. To reach her, follow the road west of the ⟦E3⟧' Crossroads. She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
rows.quest:1061:completion:0: Ah, a ⟦1⟧. Very good. We will need your skills to deal with these plunderers!
rows.quest:1063:details:0: To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.
rows.quest:1063:details:1: I do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha. I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much. If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.

rows.quest:1063:completion:0: I bid you greetings. You are here seeking council?
rows.quest:6401:obj:0: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.⟦2⟧
rows.quest:6401:details:0: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:6401:completion:0: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:6421:obj:0: Explore deep into the cave at ⟦E5⟧ and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.
rows.quest:6421:details:0: Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, ⟦4⟧?
rows.quest:6421:details:1: Southeast of here lies a deep cave in ⟦E5⟧. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave. I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.
rows.quest:6421:details:2: Go young ⟦5⟧, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
rows.quest:6421:progress:0: What news have you discovered from ⟦E5⟧? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
rows.quest:6421:completion:0: Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The Kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.
rows.quest:6421:completion:1: Legend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans. They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a ⟦E6⟧ that cannot be ignored.
rows.quest:6421:completion:3: Perhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this Kobold plot.
rows.quest:6523:obj:0: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.⟦6⟧
rows.quest:6523:details:0: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.
rows.quest:6523:details:1: My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
rows.quest:6523:completion:0: Kaya is alive! ⟦7⟧, I have you to thank for rescuing her.

rows.quest:6461:obj:0: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

rows.quest:1071:obj:0: Kill 10 Venture Co. Loggers, and 10 Venture Co. Deforesters and return to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1071:details:0: You see, ⟦31⟧, I'm a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, ⟦E18⟧ and ⟦E19⟧ Sciences, and it's my goal... nay, my DUTY! to show the night elves that a blend of magic, mixtures, and mechanisms can help save their forests.
rows.quest:1071:details:1: But it's a hard fought war, and the goblins reproduce like rabbits it seems. I haven't even had time to build my newest inventions!
rows.quest:1071:details:2: I need some time to plan and organize. But to do that, I need your help keeping the goblins at bay in Windshear Crag to the east...
rows.quest:1071:progress:0: How goes the ⟦E20⟧ on your end, ⟦32⟧?
rows.quest:1071:completion:0: Thanks so much for your help, ⟦33⟧. You're actually back just in time.
rows.quest:1071:completion:1: I think I've got the perfect plan. ⟦E21⟧. No, that's not the plan, but it's part of the plan.
rows.quest:1071:completion:2: See, I've been using high explosives--don't worry, they're not as dangerous as everyone thinks--to scare the goblins back a bit. I can herd 'em pretty good with a few key detonations along the mountains' edges, but I've been low on supplies now for a few days.
rows.quest:1072:details:0: The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last.
rows.quest:1072:details:1: And for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium.
rows.quest:1072:details:2: The only person who can make ⟦E23⟧ is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. Look for him in Tinker Town.
rows.quest:1072:details:3: You talk him into making us some ⟦E23⟧, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.
rows.quest:1072:completion:0: Ahhh. Gaxim sent you, huh? How do I know you're not lying to me?! Hmm? Hmm?
rows.quest:1073:obj:0: Bring 4 Minor ⟦E24⟧ ⟦E25⟧ and 2 ⟦E26⟧ of Minor Fortitude to Lomac Gearstrip in ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:1073:details:0: Hahaha... you need Nitromirglyceronium to stop goblins from destroying a forest?!
rows.quest:1073:details:1: I don't care if you know Gaxim or not... I'll give you the stuff just to see you or them explode into itty bitty pieces.
rows.quest:1073:details:2: There's a problem though: I'm all out.
rows.quest:1073:details:3: But I'll tell you what, you bring me the correct potions, and I'll make some up for you right away.
rows.quest:1073:details:4: The least you can do is prove you've got some skill as an alchemist before I just give you a sample of my greatest creation.
rows.quest:1073:progress:0: I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... they're vital to its creation.
rows.quest:1073:completion:1: If I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. Good, good... the world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
rows.quest:1074:obj:0: Bring the Nitromirglyceronium back to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1074:details:0: Here you go, stranger. Take heed with it though... it's volatile stuff.
rows.quest:1074:details:1: If you're really a friend of Gaxim's, then tell him I say hello. If you're not, then have fun blowin' yerself up.
rows.quest:1074:completion:0: Your task has been done flawlessly, ⟦34⟧.

rows.quest:1075:details:1: Okay, so the short of it is this: with a little magic, I can make it so the explosives go off while you're not around. I'm putting together a device that'll allow you to push just one button and have the ⟦E23⟧ explode when you're ready.
rows.quest:1075:details:2: But I need a ⟦E28⟧ from a friend in ⟦E27⟧--Collin Mauren is his name. You can find him in the mage quarter there. He's human, so he shouldn't be hard to ⟦E29⟧.

rows.quest:1076:details:3: I'll be here when you return.
rows.quest:1076:progress:0: Hello, ⟦35⟧. Have you found the component I need?
rows.quest:1076:completion:0: Allow me just a few moments and I shall have your scroll ready for you.
rows.quest:1077:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E33⟧ to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1077:details:0: Here you are, ⟦36⟧. This should do nicely.
rows.quest:1077:details:1: Please give my regards to Gaxim when next you see him. I look forward to hearing about this adventure when it sees its completion.
rows.quest:1077:progress:0: Haha! you're back! Do you have it? Do you have the ⟦E28⟧?
rows.quest:1077:completion:1: This ⟦E28⟧, mixed with the ⟦E23⟧, shall make the perfect remote explosive.
rows.quest:1077:completion:2: We'll be able to create the perfect distraction for you so you can sneak in and steal the Venture Co.'s letters and engineering plans.

rows.quest:1093:details:0: Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!
rows.quest:1093:details:1: Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!
rows.quest:1093:details:2: Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
rows.quest:1093:progress:0: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
rows.quest:1093:completion:0: Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!
rows.quest:1093:completion:1: Now, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.
rows.quest:1094:obj:0: Deliver the ⟦E36⟧ to Sputtervalve in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1094:details:0: This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the ⟦E37⟧ blueprints.
rows.quest:1094:details:1: Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the ⟦E3⟧. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
rows.quest:1094:progress:0: Hello there! How can I help you?
rows.quest:1094:completion:0: Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.
rows.quest:1094:completion:1: They do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.

rows.quest:6284:completion:1: B<Maggran rubs the wound caused by Besseleth.>

rows.quest:1079:obj:0: Retrieve the Venture Co.'s ⟦E19⟧ Plans from the lumber mill in Windshear Crag.
rows.quest:1079:details:0: This is it, ⟦39⟧. Pay close attention. The devices are done, and ready to be used.
rows.quest:1079:details:1: Take these pages--they'll explain more about the detonators and explosives, and where you should place them.

rows.quest:1079:completion:1: We'll be able to find weaknesses in their machines and also incorporate their designs into our own creations. This is a wonderful day, indeed.
rows.quest:1080:obj:0: Retrieve the ⟦E39⟧ from Windshear Mine at the east end of Windshear Crag.
rows.quest:1080:details:0: Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, ⟦41⟧.
rows.quest:1080:details:1: We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.
rows.quest:1080:details:2: The key is to get their letters... remember that.
rows.quest:1080:details:3: The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....
rows.quest:1080:completion:0: Incredible, ⟦43⟧! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
rows.quest:1082:details:0: ⟦44⟧, you have done a great deed by lending a hand here.
rows.quest:1082:details:1: The Sentinels of ⟦E14⟧ will reward you well if you informed them that Gaxim and I are alive. Tell them we are well on our way to stopping the Venture Co. and ⟦E40⟧ the lands.
rows.quest:1082:details:2: Find Tara Thenysil in Astranaar; she will be pleased to see you've returned with good news.
rows.quest:1082:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦45⟧. You have done a service to the Sentinels.

rows.quest:1090:obj:0: Get the mysterious ore from Piznik after he finishes mining it.
rows.quest:1090:details:0: You know, I was once the second most important person here at this site. That all changed when Gerenzo took over. Fired my boss, ⟦E35⟧, and sent me down to work in the mines. Ziz told me to stay here and gather information, though. His new boss will pay us well if we can find out what Gerenzo's plans are.
rows.quest:1090:details:1: Anyways, what I do know is that Gerenzo has ordered large amounts of this gold-green ore to be mined. I can get you a sample to bring to Ziz, but you'll have to watch for patrols while I get it.
rows.quest:1090:completion:0: Thanks, ⟦46⟧. It was looking a little dicey there for a second and we've probably drawn far too much attention to ourselves.

rows.quest:1091:details:0: ⟦47⟧, take these letters to Kaela. I'm sure she'll want to know about this. Or at least the Sentinels will.
rows.quest:1091:details:1: Make sure you tell her how successful we were and how we couldn't have done it without a little bit of magic.
rows.quest:1091:progress:0: Yes, ⟦48⟧? What can I do for you?
rows.quest:1091:completion:1: You and Gaxim have done very well, ⟦49⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:1092:details:0: I guess I'd better think about getting out of here, also. It won't take long for word of what happened here to spread to the higher ups, and I'm sure they wouldn't take too kindly to meeting me again.
rows.quest:1092:details:1: I'll sneak out and meet with Ziz. Hopefully, he'll be able to find me a new job!

rows.quest:1092:progress:0: Something I can help you with?

rows.quest:1092:completion:1: Of course I'll want to keep a little piece for myself, but what they don't know won't hurt them, yes?

rows.quest:1068:details:2: In my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:
rows.quest:1068:progress:0: The tree spirits wail at the loss of their brethren, ⟦50⟧. You must destroy the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, or I ⟦E11⟧ Stonetalon will never be healed.
rows.quest:1068:completion:0: The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, ⟦51⟧. With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.
